tldr: BEARCUBS is a benchmark of 111 information-seeking questions that evaluates web agents' ability to search, browse, and identify factual information from live web content through diverse multimodal interactions such as video understanding and 3D navigation.
contributions: Introduction of BEARCUBS, a 'small but mighty' benchmark of 111 QA pairs evaluating computer-using web agents on the live web
Human study showing 84.7% human accuracy on BEARCUBS questions
Benchmarking of seven commercial agents and five baselines, finding ChatGPT Agent leads at 65.8% accuracy
Emphasis on evolving dataset maintenance to combat web contamination
methods: The authors created 111 information-seeking QA pairs covering text-based and multimodal interactions (video, 3D navigation, games, etc.) on the live web, with human-validated browsing trajectories. Questions were designed to be adversarial to Google Search and filtered to remove text-based workarounds (13 questions removed). A human study was conducted with annotators timed on each question, recording dead ends and perceived difficulty. Seven agents were evaluated: four computer-using agents (ChatGPT Agent, Operator, Anthropic Computer Use, Convergence Proxy) and three non-computer-using agents (Deep Research variants), plus five baselines.
results: Human accuracy was 84.7% (4 min 46 sec average, 1.5 dead ends per question). ChatGPT Agent achieved the highest accuracy at 65.8%, followed by OpenAI Deep Research at 36.0% (largely through guessing on multimodal items), and Operator at 23.4%. ChatGPT Agent scored 54.5% on multimodal questions vs 76.8% on text-based. All agents significantly underperformed humans. Zero-shot baselines scored as low as 8.1% (DeepSeek-R1), confirming BEARCUBS cannot be solved by parametric knowledge or simple search augmentation.
limitations: Benchmark requires manual agent evaluation due to lack of API access, making it costly (20+ minutes per question for some agents)
Web contamination risk necessitates periodic updates; the paper acknowledges ongoing maintenance is required
Agent sessions were terminated after 15 minutes, potentially cutting off valid but slow trajectories
Even the best agent trails human performance substantially, indicating significant gaps in fine control, complex data filtering, and execution speed
